description: This file defines the MemEntryImpl class, which implements cache entry management for a memory-only cache in the net disk cache system. It supports parent and child entries, sparse caching, and related operations.

classes.name: MemEntryImpl
classes.description: Implements cache entry interface for in-memory cache, supporting parent/child and sparse caching.

methods.name: InUse
methods.description: Checks if the entry is currently in use.

methods.name: UpdateStateOnUse
methods.description: Updates the entry's position in LRU and last used time, optionally last modified.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with the entry.

methods.name: GetLastUsed
methods.description: Returns the last time the entry was used.

methods.name: GetDataSize
methods.description: Returns size of data at a given index.

methods.name: ReadSparseData
methods.description: Reads sparse data at a given offset.

methods.name: WriteSparseData
methods.description: Writes sparse data at a given offset.

methods.name: GetAvailableRange
methods.description: Gets available data range in the entry.

methods.name: CouldBeSparse
methods.description: Checks if the entry could be sparse.

methods.name: ReadyForSparseIO
methods.description: Prepares the entry for sparse I/O.

methods.name: SetLastUsedTimeForTest
methods.description: Sets last used time for testing purposes.
